project.title: PortProof: Verified SQL Migration to Db2
project.short_description: Translates PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server and SQLite SQL to Db2 and makes Db2 itself prove the result, first that it compiles through a server side PREPARE, then that it returns the same answers through differential execution against the real source engine over adversarial datasets that a dataset agent builds for any schema. On 125 statements IBM's own translator reported no error; Db2 rejected 17, and 66 more compiled while silently returning different rows. All 17 were repaired and re verified, and 50 of the 66 were repaired and re proved, by a tiered repair that asks Db2's fix memory first, measured rules second and a language model last. The model never reads source data, so its cost does not grow with the database: identical prompts at 2,000 and 2,000,000 source rows, and 80 model calls on the first run fall to 2 by the fourth because Db2 remembers every answer.

members.name: Vishnu
members.role: Solo entry: Db2 schema and SQL PL, compile oracle, differential prover over four source engines and its soundness guards, dataset agent with its Db2 cache and yield log, tiered and metered repair (fix memory, rules, model), LangGraph compile repair loop, semantic repair loop, Db2 vector fix memory, Streamlit UI, test suite

features_used: PREPARE as a compile oracle, server side, with DeferredPrepare=0 so the SQLCODE is the engine's own
VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) columns and VECTOR_DISTANCE(..., COSINE)
CREATE VECTOR INDEX ... WITH DISTANCE COSINE, with FETCH APPROX FIRST recall
Hybrid vector and relational recall evaluated in a single statement
JSON_VALUE(... RETURNING ...) typed extraction for metadata predicates
SQL PL stored procedures, including MERGE upsert and a cursor loop with CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND
HASH(..., 2) SHA-256 certificates computed inside the engine over the proof evidence
System versioned temporal tables and FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF
MQT with REFRESH IMMEDIATE MAINTAINED BY SYSTEM
Expression based index on UPPER(CASE_NAME)
COLLATION_KEY_BIT at UCA strength 1 and strength 3 to reproduce MySQL and PostgreSQL collation on Db2
CHECK and UNIQUE constraints, FOREIGN KEY ON DELETE CASCADE
WLM service class, workload matched on CURRENT CLIENT_APPLNAME, SQLROWSRETURNED and ESTIMATEDSQLCOST thresholds
32K bufferpool and tablespace, required for a 384 dimension vector index key
Two identity least privilege split enforced by GRANT
ADMIN_GET_TAB_COMPRESS_INFO and SYSCAT.TABLES compression measurement
ORGANIZE BY COLUMN (BLU) availability check
MON_GET_PKG_CACHE_STMT workload hotspots

Federation: a JDBC wrapper, POSTGRESQL and MYSQL servers, user mappings to read only remote accounts, and nicknames, so one Db2 statement compares the source rows against Db2's own with EXCEPT ALL in both directions
SYSCAT catalog introspection
One schema per adversarial dataset with SET CURRENT SCHEMA, so each dataset is loaded once and the SQL under test is never rewritten
JSON_EXISTS inside a SQL PL procedure with SIGNAL SQLSTATE to validate a dataset payload at the only write path
A dataset cache, a per dataset yield log with an aggregating view, a model call ledger and a dead end table, all written only through SQL PL procedures

ai_models: Tiered repair, the default: Db2 fix memory, then a deterministic rule engine, then a language model
gemini-flash-latest through an OpenAI compatible endpoint as the model tier (optional; any compatible endpoint works, and with no key the first two tiers run alone)
